name: B10-0381/2026 – Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the draft Commission implementing decision renewing the authorisation for the placing on the market of products containing, consisting of or produced from genetically modified maize MON 87460 pursuant to Regulation (EC) No 1829/2003 of the European Parliament and of the Council
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to withdraw its plan to renew the licence for importing a type of genetically modified maize, called MON 87460. The maize is not grown in the EU, but it can be imported for food and animal feed. Parliament says the safety checks did not look at long-term effects, the buildup of effects over time, or the extra weedkillers used with such crops. It also says most EU countries did not back the plan.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament only asks the Commission to drop the renewal plan.
- **Who it affects:** EU importers, food and feed businesses, farmers, and consumers.
- **What happens next:** The Commission decides whether to withdraw, change or keep its plan.
